name: Mnemonic 300M
about: 24 layers, pretrained on 10B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, then tuned for chat on smol-smoltalk. The newest and best Mnemonic. int8 weights: the same quality as full precision at a quarter of the size.

name: Mnemonic 300M, small download
about: The 300M with int4 weights. A 40% smaller download and a little faster, but noticeably less sharp.

name: Mnemonic 126M
about: The first Mnemonic: 16 layers, pretrained on 5B tokens of FineWeb-Edu, then tuned for chat on smol-smoltalk. Smaller and about twice as fast as the 300M.

name: Mnemonic 126M, small download
about: The 126M with int4 weights, the smallest download.
